column1: # Reference word lists for tools/language/find.py --like: everyday words of each profile in broad phonemic IPA, written
# from the standard descriptions named per block (English is not here: find.py uses tools/language/sketch.py ENGLISH_WORDS).
# They feed the sound texture (segment-class frequencies, word-final classes), the final-vowel share and the word length;
# meanings need not match the run's concepts. Tolkien lists use attested words only.
# japanese: Vance, The Sounds of Japanese (2008); broad phonemic, r as ɾ
# finnish: Suomi, Toivanen & Ylitalo, Finnish Sound Structure (2008)
# arabic: Ryding, A Reference Grammar of Modern Standard Arabic (2005); pausal forms
# mandarin: Duanmu, The Phonology of Standard Chinese (2007); tones left out of the texture
# georgian: Aronson, Georgian: A Reading Grammar (1990); Shosted & Chikovani, JIPA (2006)
# welsh: Hannahs, The Phonology of Welsh (2013); northern vowels
# sindarin: Tolkien, LotR and Appendix E; Salo, A Gateway to Sindarin (2004)
# quenya: Tolkien, LotR Appendix E and 'Namárië'; Fauskanger, Quenya Course (2004)
# spanish: Hualde, The Sounds of Spanish (2005); Castilian
# zulu: Poulos & Bosch, Zulu (1997); Doke (1926); b = implosive ɓ
# turkish: Göksel & Kerslake, Turkish: A Comprehensive Grammar (2005)
# klingon: Okrand, The Klingon Dictionary (1992); IPA after Okrand's descriptions
# black_speech: Tolkien, LotR (Ring inscription; Uglúk's curse) and Appendix F; Parma Eldalamberon 17 (2007)
